title: Level 9: Gradle, Build Engineering, and CI/CD
description: Engineer predictable Android builds and trusted releases through Gradle models, Android variants, tested convention plugins, measured cache correctness, signed artifacts, protected CI/CD, provenance, staged rollout, and recovery.
plannedTopics: Gradle lifecycle, lazy task graphs, deterministic inputs and parallel-safe work
Android variants, dependency governance, locking, verification, and public AGP APIs
Convention plugins, typed extensions, code generation, TestKit, and build-platform ownership
Measured configuration, compilation, caching, KSP, ABI, and dependency performance
Signed App Bundles, R8 outputs, symbols, release tracks, GitHub Actions security, attestations, rollout, and recovery

project.title: Trusted Convention Plugin and Release Pipeline
project.summary: Create a tested Android convention-plugin suite and a protected pipeline that produces, verifies, attests, promotes, observes, and recovers exact signed release artifacts.

theme.mapMood: A build pipeline where inputs, outputs, caches, and releases are traceable.
